reason: owner-gated: this workflow implements no path that posts. Publishing exists ONLY as the separate explicit owner-approved action `career-ops/linkedin_publish.py publish --approve-publish --confirm-token <sha256 of the draft body>`; it is dry-run by default, never scrapes or reuses a browser session, and records the post URN/timestamp/result
policy: External LinkedIn messaging, connection requests, reactions, follows, profile edits and application submission are OWNER-GATED. This workflow refuses them and records the refusal; it implements no path that performs them. Publishing a POST is the single implemented account mutation and it lives in a separate module (career-ops/linkedin_publish.py) behind an explicit owner approval for that exact action; nothing is ever published silently.

owner_approved_publish_action.command: python career-ops/linkedin_publish.py publish --drafts <draft artefact> --kind post --index N --approve-publish --confirm-token <sha256 of the exact draft body>
owner_approved_publish_action.transport: LinkedIn official REST API (https://api.linkedin.com/rest/posts) with an OAuth 2.0 member token (openid profile w_member_social)
owner_approved_publish_action.credential_store: Windows Credential Manager generic credentials via career-ops/linkedin_auth.py; never the repository, never a command line, never a log
requires: --confirm-token equal to the sha256 of the exact draft body being approved
no matching entry already in the local published ledger (or --allow-duplicate)
safeguards: duplicate-post prevention via a local body-hash ledger
bounded retries (429/5xx/transport only; a 4xx is never retried)
post URN, post URL, timestamp, HTTP status and body hash recorded; no token recorded
